text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it was totally the best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It felt like kicking into another gear 
compared to tandem training or mock 
races—it was irresistible!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking that I'll get to feel like this 
every time I run from now on makes me so 
happy♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-kun, now that the debut's 
successfully out of the way, what should 
we aim for next?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-chan, now that the debut's 
successfully out of the way, what should 
we aim for next?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're doing this, how about aiming 
for the greatest stage of all?"

The "ultimate stage" she spoke of must be 
that race... the one that crowns the 
Junior-class champion.

With her caliber, it's no mere dream, and 
I want to see her gallop on the greatest 
stage, so our next goal is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: As expected, you really get it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Abso-tootly-lutely! It's an OK! Let's aim 
for it at full throttle!

And so, Maruzensky successfully ran 
through her debut race.
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's give it everything in 
training today!
choice_data_list:
You just finished a race, you could take a 
break, you know.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? We made a Gâ 
our goal, so we've gotta work hard for it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Maruzensky-san! Excuse me, but may we 
have an interview?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You're already being called a "supercar"— 
what are your thoughts on that!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an interview? But I'm just about to 
start training, you know~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know! If you can catch me, I'll give you 
an interview! Here I go~!
(Slash-slash-slash-slash!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
C-Catch them? When our opponents are 
Umamusume!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"We'll pincer it! Chase it from over 
there!"

Maruzensky dashed around playing tag with 
the reporters. From behind, she looked 
like she was having the time of her life.
